title: Maximum Capacity Utilisation Rates of Changi Airport's Existing Terminals and Update on Construction of Terminal 5
what_it_is: Maximum Capacity Utilisation Rates of Changi Airport's Existing Terminals and Update on Construction of Terminal 5

sections.label: Changi Airport capacity and Terminal 5
sections.summary: Annualised figure is about 70% of Changi's 90 million passenger capacity; Terminal 5 construction begins first half of 2025 and will add 50 million passengers yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: On an annualised basis, this is about 70% of Changi Airport’s annual handling capacity of 90 million passengers across Terminals 1 to 4.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: The construction of Terminal 5 is on track to begin in the first half of 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: When Terminal 5 is operational in the mid-2030s, it will be able to handle an additional 50 million passengers a year.

sections.label: Lessons learnt and 2025 levels
sections.summary: The passage asks about lessons learnt and preparations to prevent such an incident, and states that in 2025 pre-COVID-19 levels are very likely to be exceeded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: Are there any lessons learnt and how are we preparing ourselves to prevent the occurrence of such an incident?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, in 2025, we are very likely to exceed pre-COVID-19 levels.

sections.label: Changi Airport Group investment
sections.summary: Changi Airport Group will invest $3 billion over six years in Terminals 1 to 4 to improve baggage handling, check in and immigration, and the aviation workforce has exceeded pre-COVID-19 levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The Changi Airport Group will invest $3 billion over the next six years in Singapore Changi Airport Terminals 1 to 4 to improve services such as baggage handling, check in and immigration.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: These investments will help Changi Airport to stay competitive and to meet rising demand for air travel before Terminal 5 is operational in the mid-2030s.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The aviation workforce has also exceeded pre-COVID-19 levels.

sections.label: CAAS contact with authorities
sections.summary: CAAS is in touch with the Korean Civil Aviation Authority, the United States Federal Aviation Administration and Boeing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: CAAS is in touch with their counterpart, the Korean Civil Aviation Authority, as well as the United States Federal Aviation Administration and Boeing.
